csv_scope_of_work: The City of Clayton is accepting qualification packages from interested engineering, architectural, surveying, geotechnical, and landscape architecture firms for professional services for a variety of project in the City of Clayton, Missouri. The scope of work for projects may include but is not limited to the following categories: Streetscape, Lighting, and Landscape Architecture Roadway/Alley Rehabilitation and Reconstruction, including Sidewalks and ADA compliance Traffic, Signals, and Intersections Public Facilities (Public Buildings, Public Works Facilities) Stormwater Management and Low Impact Development Geotechnical Engineering and Materials Testing Surveying, Mapping, and GIS Project Management (both locally and federally funded projects, from inception to completion)

title: On-Call Engineering Consultant Services - Clayton 2027-29
short_description: On-call multidisciplinary consulting services for various municipal infrastructure and public facility projects.
project_scope: On-call professional services for a variety of City of Clayton projects, including streetscape, lighting and landscape architecture; roadway and alley rehabilitation and reconstruction including sidewalks and ADA compliance; traffic signals and intersections; public facilities such as public buildings and public works facilities; stormwater management and low impact development; geotechnical engineering and materials testing; surveying, mapping and GIS; and project management for locally and federally funded projects.
services: Multidisciplinary on-call consulting services including architecture, landscape architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, construction/project management, materials testing, sanitation engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, stormwater, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style on-call consulting for multiple unspecified municipal projects.
- Scope is broad and mostly general civil, streets/highways, stormwater, surveying, and project management.
- No clearly defined bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special structural engineering component.
- Includes architecture/public facilities, but without a specific large or complex building opportunity.
- Framework agreements without technical specification are generally low priority for sbp, especially when structural relevance is unclear.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. The procurement is for on-call consultant services covering multiple future projects over a 36-month base period with a 12-month renewal option, so no realistic single-project construction cost can be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee or contract value is stated. Up to 3 contracts may be awarded for on-call services, but the notice provides no upset limit, task-order volume, or estimated annual spend.
references_qualifications: Interested firms are invited to submit qualification packages for professional services in disciplines including architecture, landscape architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, construction/project management, materials testing, sanitation engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, stormwater, and traffic design engineering. Specific reference counts or minimum qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided notice.
contracting_authority: City of Clayton, Clayton, Missouri, USA. Contact: Richard Wilburn. Phone: 314-290-8565. Email: rwilburn@claytonmo.gov. Website: https://www.claytonmo.gov/Home/Components/RFP/RFP/356/313
notes: Target market is Streets/Highways, but the notice does not specifically mention bridges. This is an RFQ/RFP for renewable on-call services, base period 36 months plus 12-month renewal option, with up to 3 contracts to be awarded. Category assigned pragmatically due to municipal transportation focus, although the opportunity is not bridge-specific.
